alloy: all u: Unit | miscited[u] implies u in Misnesting
all a: Axiom, v: Unit | (cites[a, v] and v not in Axiom) implies a in Misnesting

all s: Spec | (some v: Unit | cites[s, v] and v not in Axiom and v not in Spec and v not in Fact) implies s in Misnesting
all b: Bug, i: Issue | (b->i in Name.issue and i in Closed) implies b in OutdatedTracking
doubt: 'it' read as the bug, not the issue.

all c: Conflict | hidden[c] implies c in Finding
all g: Tag | (no u: Unit | g->u in Name.tag) implies g in Rotting
all t: Test | adrift[t] implies t in Finding
all t: Test | (t in Declared and (no g: Tag | t->g in Carry.rel)) implies t in Uncitation
all d1, d2: Document | d1->d2 in Extend.rel implies (d1->d2 in Context.rel and (all x: Document | d2->x in Context.rel implies d1->x in Context.rel))

no Tracker implies (all u: Unit | u not in Untracking)

all r: Run | ((some f: Frontmatter, m: Missing | lists[f, m]) or (some d: Document | d in Unreadable) or (some c: Command | r->c in Ask.rel and not available[c]) or (some p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code2)) implies r in Exits2
all f: Foreign | f in Refused
all f: Unclosed | f in Refused
all f: Unterminated | f in Refused
(some f: Frontmatter, p: Missing | lists[f, p]) implies (all r: Run | r in Exits2)
all r: Run, c: Command | (r->c in Ask.rel and not available[c]) implies (c in Unknown and r in Exits2)
all r: Run, c: Command | (r->c in Ask.rel and not available[c]) implies c in Unknown
all d1, d2: Document | d1->d2 in Bare.rel implies (d1 in Finding iff d2 in Finding)

no Finding and (some d: Document, a: Axiom, s: Spec, i: Index, t: Test, g: Tag | d->a in Hold.units and d->s in Hold.units and s->a in Sit.rel and d->i in Hold.indexes and i->d in Match.rel and t in Declared and t->g in Carry.rel and g->s in Name.tag)

alloy: some b: Bug, e: ExpectedFailure, i: Issue | b->i in Name.issue and i in Known and i not in Closed and checks[e, b] and b not in Finding and e not in Finding
all u: Unit | (u in Generated and u not in Differs and u not in Unsayable) implies u in Current
doubt: 'generated statement' read as Generated; 'would say exactly the same' as not Differs.

alloy: all u: Unit | (u in Logical and u in Stated and u not in Generated and u not in Unsayable) implies u in Handwritten
all u: Unit | (u in Wordless or u in Twofold) implies u in Unsayable
all u: Unit | u in Wordless implies u in Unsayable
all u: Unit | u in Current implies u not in Reported
doubt: 'it' read as the statement (Reported), not the unit as a finding.

alloy: all r: Run, c: CheckCommand | (r->c in Ask.rel and (some u: Unit | u in Reported)) implies r not in Exits0
all r: Run, c: GenerateCommand, u: Unit | (r->c in Ask.rel and u in Handwritten) implies (u in Reported and r not in Exits0)
all w: Word | (w in Undeclared or w in Misplaced or w in Apart or w in Unused) implies w in Flagged
all d: Document, u: Unit | (d->u in Hold.units and d not in Checked and (some e: Checked | e->d in Context.rel)) implies u not in Rewritten
all d1, d2: Document, u1, u2: Unit, w: Word | (d1->d2 in Context.rel and d1->u1 in Hold.units and u1->w in Voice.rel and d2->u2 in Hold.units and u2->w in Introduce.rel) implies w not in Undeclared
all s: Scenario | s in Possible implies s not in Raised
all s: Scenario, u: Unit | (s in Raised and u->s in Frees.rel) implies s->u in Blame.rel
all s: Scenario, u: Unit | s->u in Blame.rel implies u->s in Frees.rel
all u: Unit | u in Contradicting implies u in Named
all u: Unit, w: Signature | (loneOn[u, w] and u in Logical and u not in Term) implies u->w in Expose.rel

alloy: all u: Unit, w: Word | u->w in Expose.rel implies u in Unchallenged
all u: Unit, w: Word | u->w in Expose.rel implies (u in Logical and u not in Term and w in Signature and loneOn[u, w])
all u1, u2: Unit, w: Word | (u2 != u1 and u2->w in Utter.rel) implies u1->w not in Expose.rel
some u: Unit, w: Signature | u in Logical and u->w in Rely.rel and u->w not in Expose.rel
all l: Series | (l in OneLineRule and l not in TimeFirst) implies l in OneLine
all d: Definition | (d in GuardedByKind and byKind[d]) implies d in PhrasePerKind
all q: Quantifier | q in VariableTwice implies q in InFull
all q: Quantifier | q in NothingToAttach implies q in InFull
all q: Quantifier | q in NoWithAnother implies q in InFull
all l: Series | l in RelativeBeforeLast implies l in AsBullets
all l: Series | l in NotClause implies l in AsBullets
all l: Series | l in AndInOr implies l in KeepsAndApart
all l: Series | (l in OneLineRule and l not in TimeFirst and l in TimeSecond) implies l in KeepsThen
some d: Definition | d in OrInsideKind and d in NoKindFirst
some l: Series | l in MoreThanTwo and l in Few and l in CommaItem
some l: Series | l in Few and l in TooLong

always ((all o: Owner, c: Failing | (runNow[c] and c->o in on and o in Disposed) implies always o not in Threw) and (all o, h: Owner, c: Failing | (o->h in handler and runNow[c] and c->o in on and o in Disposed) implies eventually c->h in reached))
doubt: 'runs on a disposed owner' read as runNow[c] with c on o and o disposed at that moment.

alloy: some o, h: Owner | o != h and o->h in handler and eventually (some c: Failing | dispose[o] and c->o in on and eventually (runNow[c] and eventually c->h in reached))
doubt: 'while a failing cleanup is on it' read as the cleanup being on the owner at the moment of the dispose.
